265248.Description: This premium collector's set contains 18 fan-favorite cards, hand-picked by both fans and the design team. Cards in this product have been reprinted with a unique textured silver foiling.

270513.Description:
[Counter Attack] If your Leader Card is red : Negate the attack. You may choose 1 card in your hand and discard it. If you do, choose one-
• Your opponent can't attack with Battle Cards with 20000 power or more for the turn.
• Your opponent can't attack with Unison Cards with 20000 power or more for the turn.

270514.Description:
[EX-Evolve] 1, place 2 "Universe 7" from your hand in the Drop Area : "Universe 7" "Son Goku" with an energy cost of 5 or more.
[Triple Attack] (Twice per turn, when this card attacks, switch this card to Active Mode after the battle)
[Critical]
[Auto] When this card attacks, if your Leader Card is green, choose up to 1 card from your opponent's hand or up to 1 of their Battle Cards and place it in the Drop Area.

270515.Description:
[Counter:Play] You can't activate the [Counter:Play] skills of other cards for the turn : Play this card from your hand.
[Permanent] When you have a green Unison Card with 2 or more markers in play, you can activate this card's [Counter] skill from your hand without paying its energy cost.
[Auto] When this card is played, choose up to 1 of your opponent's Battle Cards with an energy cost of 7 or less and KO it.

270516.Description:
[Unique]
[Auto] If it's your opponent's turn : At the end of a battle where this card is used in a combo, play up to 1 skill-less Battle Card with an energy cost of 2 or less from your deck or Drop Area, shuffle your deck if you looked through it, and you can't activate the [Auto] skill on copies of this card for the turn.
[Activate:Main] 1, send 1 skill-less Battle Card from your Drop Area to your Warp : Play this card from your hand.

270517.Description:
[Auto] If your Leader Card is a red "Earthling"-only card with 10000 power or less : When this card is used in a combo, flip up to 1 card in your life face up; at the end of the turn, flip all face-up cards in your life face down. You can't activate the [Auto] skill on copies of this card for the turn.
[Activate:Battle] If your Leader Card is a red "Earthling"-only card with 5000 power : Combo with this card from your Drop Area; at the end of the battle, send this card from your Drop Area to your Warp.

270518.Description:
[Counter:Attack] Negate the attack, then play this card.
[Permanent] During your opponent's turn, if you have a blue Unison Card in play, reduce the energy cost of this card in your hand by 2.
[Auto] When this card is played, your opponent can't attack with Battle Cards with energy costs greater than their current energy for the turn unless they choose 2 cards in their hand and place them at the bottom of their deck in any order.

270519.Description:
[Over Realm 6]
[Auto] When this card is played using [Over Realm], place up to 3 black Battle Cards from your Warp in your Drop Area.
[Activate:Battle] (-), if your Leader Card is black and you discard this card from your hand : Place 1 card from your life in your Drop Area, and your Leader Card doesn't take damage for the battle.

270520.Description:
[Counter:Attack] Negate the attack, then play this card.
[Permanent] If your Leader Card is yellow and your opponent has 2 or more energy, reduce the energy cost of this card in your hand by 1 for each yellow Extra Card in your Energy Area and Drop Area.
[Auto] When this card is played from your hand, each time your opponent would attack with a non-Unison Card this turn, they must choose 1 of their cards in Active Mode and switch it to Rest Mode. [Activate:Main] : Choose up to 1 yellow "Frieza" card with an energy cost of 4 and {Mecha} in its card name in your hand and play it on top of this card.

270521.Description:
[Double Strike]
[Union-Fusion] 3, if your Leader Card is a black "Saiyan"-only card : "Son Goku: Xeno" and "Vegeta: Xeno".
[Permanent] You can choose Battle Cards in your Warp when choosing cards to use with this card's [Union] skill from your hand. If you do, place the chosen cards in your Drop Area from your Warp.
[Activate:Main] [Once per turn] Place 1 "Son Goku: Xeno" card with 5000 power and 1 "Vegeta: Xeno" card with 5000 power in your Drop Area from your Warp : Switch this card to Active Mode.
270521.BANDAI Disclaimer: This promotional card is marked “Not For Sale” by BANDAI, as the manufacturer prefers that Stores do not sell these cards.

270522.Description:
[Counter:Attack] Negate the attack, then play this card in Rest Mode.
[Auto] If your Leader Card is blue and you place this card in Rest Mode at the bottom of its owner's deck : When your opponent attacks a Leader Card, choose up to 1 of your Leader Cards and it gets +5000 power for the turn.
270522.BANDAI Disclaimer: This promotional card is marked “Not For Sale” by BANDAI, as the manufacturer prefers that Stores do not sell these cards.

270523.Description:
[Super Combo]
[Energy-Exhaust]
[Auto] If your Leader Card is blue or green : When you combo with this card from your hand, your opponent chooses 1 card in their hand and places it at the bottom of their deck.

270524.Description:
[Super Combo]
[Energy-Exhaust]
[Auto] If your Leader Card is red or blue and it's your opponent's turn : When you combo with this card from your hand, choose up to 1 of your Red/Blue multicolor energy and switch it to Active Mode.

270525.Description:
[Super Combo]
[Energy-Exhaust]
[Auto] If your Leader Card is green or yellow : When you combo with this card from your hand, choose up to 1 green or yellow Battle Card with an energy cost of 4 or less from your deck, place it in your Drop Area, then shuffle your deck.

270526.Description:
[Permanent] Only 1 copy of this card can be played in your Battle Area.
[Permanent] Reduce the energy cost of this card in your hand by 1 for each of your blue Battle Cards.
[Activate:Main] [Once per turn] Draw 2 cards, then at the start of your opponent's next Main Phase, choose up to 2 of your blue energy and switch them to Active Mode.

270527.Description:
[Auto] When this card attacks, choose one –
• Draw 1 card.
• Switch up to 1 of your mono-blue energy to Active Mode.
[Awaken] When your life is at 4 or less : You may draw 2 cards and flip this card over.

SSGSS Son Goku, Soul Striker Reborn
[Auto] When this card attacks, draw 1 card, then switch up to 2 of your mono-blue energy to Active Mode.
[Auto] At the end of your turn, choose up to 1 of your blue Unison Cards and switch it to Active Mode.

[Super Combo]
[Energy-Exhaust]
[Auto] If your Leader Card is red or green : At the end of a battle in which you combo with this card from your hand, play this card.

270741.Description:
[Super Combo]
[Energy-Exhaust]
[Auto] If your Leader Card is red or yellow : When you combo with this card from your hand, choose up to 1 of your opponent's Battle Cards and it gets -10000 power for the duration of the turn.

270742.Description:
[Super Combo]
[Energy-Exhaust]
[Auto] If your Leader Card is blue or yellow : When you combo with this card from your hand, choose up to 1 of your opponent's Leader Cards or Battle Cards and switch it to Rest Mode.
